answers.core:
Yes
Add on cannot add button by itself unless godot core allows it. So in my opinion this is a core feature
answers.workaround:
Yes currently there is a workaround

```
@tool

@export var myButton: bool: 
      set(value):
           if(Engine.is_editor_hint()):   //so that it only executes in editor
                myButton = false           //keeping it false so that it doesn't get checked not required but I prefer it
                // This will be executed every time it is clicked

```
With this job gets done but 
- It is not a button and hence cannot rename it or add icon to it (Add metadata has + icon)
- It requires tool just for this specific purpose
